name: pos-instrument-replay-plan-docs
title: Docs: land the proof-or-stop evidence-instrument replay & tamper campaign execution plan (rev 3)
description: The paper's thesis (trust the evidence, not the agent) rests on evidence-chain primitives whose own trust story is only anecdotal: the memory/playbook runtime baseline instrument (1k/1M gold-checked corpus, digest-bound verifier) has a single-shot smoke and one manual demo, but no systematic replay-determinism, tamper-matrix, or unattended-campaign proof. The operator approved (2026-07-05) landing the reviewed execution plan as the pre-registration for a 5-milestone deterministic campaign (M0 protocol freeze -> M1 tamper matrix -> M2 replay driver+ledger -> M3 resume probe -> M4 offline verdict, M5 optional cross-vendor babysitter-scoring pilot). This docs story commits the plan document only; implementation follows as per-milestone stories.
